purpose: Prepare a fail-closed owner-access password-reset ceremony for the unique password-ready PLATFORM_OWNER who is MFA-not-enrolled and login-not-ready. This PR only defines and validates the bounded authority; it does not execute a reset or mutate production.
requiredInvariants: The generic auth.staff_reviewer_password_reset_subject() authority and its immutable reset runner remain unchanged.

The dedicated owner subject requires exact readiness 1|1|1|1|1|1|0|0, one active PLATFORM_OWNER, the fixed internal membership and organization, a usable bcrypt password, no current or legacy MFA material and no credential-state lock.

The owner subject is SECURITY DEFINER under confined pc_staff_authority with row_security on and a fixed search_path; PUBLIC and every application runtime role are denied EXECUTE except pc_staff_runtime.

pc_staff_runtime remains table-free. The new subject body is statically and at migration time proved free of DML and dynamic SQL, clears legacy admission markers, and neither narrows nor widens the existing pc_staff_authority admission ACLs.

The isolated PostgreSQL DR convergence restores the owner-access subject to pc_staff_authority, revokes PUBLIC and non-staff runtime execution, regrants only pc_staff_runtime, and proves the restored boundary.

The production job accepts only the initial issue_comment run attempt and only when the triggering owner command is the sole matching command comment on issue 3072; reruns and duplicate command comments are denied before secrets or production access.

A cryptographically random correlation is created inside REG.RU only after exact-runtime and subject guards pass, is never published, and binds the durable outbox probe without a public pre-seed value.

The real account login throttle is derived inside the API container with AUTH_TOKEN_PEPPER and read through pc_auth_runtime in a read-only transaction; an active lock fails closed and this ceremony never clears or mutates throttle state.
Both public HTTPS requests ignore user curl configuration and proxies, then use curl --resolve for the fixed REG.RU address while preserving the production TLS SNI and Host boundary.
The exact API, Web and auth-mail-worker container identities, revisions and readiness are rechecked immediately before the POST and after durable-outbox observation; any cutover race fails closed.

No reviewer email, reset token, password, TOTP secret, backup code, SMTP credential, SSH key, database URL, cookie or decrypted auth-mail payload may cross the REG.RU SSH boundary or enter GitHub evidence.
A pull_request event executes contract checks only; the production job is issue_comment-only and requires the exact owner command on issue 3072.
No production reset is authorized by this PR-preparation scope. A post-merge run requires exact-main release/parity and separate explicit owner authorization.
acceptance: Changed paths equal this six-path allow-list and pass the source-controlled autopilot guard.
The forward-only migration preserves the generic reset function and adds only the bounded owner-access subject projection.
The dedicated owner runner is static, contains no runtime source rewriting, and performs at most one ordinary forgot-password POST after every guard passes.

The contract proves exact command provenance, initial-run-only execution, exact-main/runtime parity, a fixed HTTPS endpoint, subject ACLs, table-free runtime, no direct auth writes, no secret output and pull-request mutation NONE.
After merge, deployment and a separately authorized run, success additionally requires HTTP 202 and exactly one correlated durable PASSWORD_RESET outbox row in SENT.
